auditScope: All 9 local-life issues, 19 cross-domain research/technical blockers; sources are potential original data providers and downloads, NOT a claim of completed ingestion, verified public license, or established local effect.
accuracy: Source URLs are public documentation/portals from identified primary and secondary providers. Underlying raw data, exact geographic joins, license and freshness require separate validation. Missing is never zero.

sources.name: ACS detailed tables
sources.limitations: ACS data are historical sample estimates; ZCTAs are not USPS postal districts; API now requires a key.

sources.name: TIGER / Line boundaries
sources.limitations: Geometry is statistical; address-point and electoral boundary joins require specific effective dates.

sources.name: HUD Small Area Fair Market Rents
sources.limitations: Program rent benchmarks are not asking rents, signed lease rates or an average bill.

sources.name: HUD public housing information
sources.limitations: No individual tenant identity collection allowed.

sources.name: FHFA House Price Index
sources.limitations: Market movement is not a causal estimate of financial-firm ownership.

sources.name: HMDA mortgage lending data
sources.limitations: Mortgage origination is not landlord ownership or household rent.

sources.name: County assessor and recorder directory
sources.limitations: Property deed and beneficial owner matching require jurisdiction-specific and privacy-aware handling.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR company filings and Exhibit 21
sources.limitations: Exhibit 21 can omit immaterial subsidiaries; public shareholders do not automatically control local outlets.

sources.name: SEC Schedules 13D and 13G
sources.limitations: Beneficial holdings and control rights are not always equivalent; filing updates can lag.

sources.name: FTC merger decisions and competition
sources.limitations: Complaint is an allegation; case disposition and market definition matter.

sources.name: DOJ Antitrust case records
sources.limitations: Claims, proposed settlements, final orders and effects must be separated.

sources.name: National Database of Childcare Prices
sources.agency: U.S. Department of Labor Women's Bureau
sources.limitations: County childcare price, not 2026 tuition or a ZIP-specific quote; many local data gaps.

sources.name: Child Care and Development Fund
sources.agency: HHS Administration for Children and Families
sources.limitations: State market-rate surveys, reimbursement rates and provider eligibility must be checked state by state.

sources.name: State and local childcare licensing authorities
sources.limitations: License roster is not an ownership registry or verified current childcare availability.

sources.name: Common Core of Data school directory
sources.limitations: School location does not prove assignment; school quality needs contextual measures.

sources.name: School System Finances
sources.limitations: Funding is not directly comparable to tuition or student outcomes without enrollment and accounting.

sources.name: State education agency directory
sources.agency: U.S. Department of Education / state agencies
sources.limitations: Exact school boundaries and district ratings vary by jurisdiction.

sources.name: USDA 2025 SNAP Retailer Access Map
sources.limitations: Distance and store access are not grocery item prices; SNAP retailer list excludes some types.

sources.name: USDA SNAP Retailer Locator
sources.limitations: SNAP authorization is not full grocery availability, pricing or corporate ownership.

sources.name: BLS Consumer Price Index and Average Prices
sources.limitations: Index levels cannot be added to dollar bills; average basket is not an individual receipt.

sources.name: FTC grocery supply-chain report
sources.limitations: Historical broad industry results, not current specific grocer's price premium.

sources.name: Open Food Facts revisions
sources.limitations: Crowd-sourced item attributes require verification and licensing; product changes are not price proofs.

sources.name: EIA-861 utility-level sales and revenues
sources.limitations: Realized average revenue per kWh is not a customer's tariff; exact service territory missing.

sources.name: EIA electricity price and utility FAQ
sources.limitations: Individual retail rate schedules vary by customer class, supplier, location and time.

sources.name: Public utility commission directory
sources.agency: National Association of Regulatory Utility Commissioners
sources.limitations: NARUC is a directory; binding rate decisions come from individual state commission orders.

sources.name: EIA natural gas prices
sources.limitations: Not a customer heating bill, which also depends on quantity and efficiency.

sources.name: CMS Hospital Price Transparency
sources.limitations: Negotiated rates are not individual copays, and compliance/file interpretation differ.

sources.name: CMS Care Compare
sources.limitations: Provider listings do not ensure appointment availability or network acceptance.

sources.name: NPPES provider registry
sources.limitations: NPI is not a verified corporate ultimate-owner ID.

sources.name: State insurance department directory
sources.limitations: Actual premium filings and insurance product eligibility require separate source review.

sources.name: FTC PBM pricing research
sources.limitations: Revenue above drug acquisition cost is not automatically net profit or patient excess payment.

sources.name: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages
sources.limitations: Industry wages are not employer-specific; cell suppression and changing industry mixes.

sources.name: Local Area Unemployment Statistics
sources.limitations: Local unemployment is not household income or jobs offered by a named company.

sources.name: County Business Patterns / ZIP business patterns
sources.limitations: Establishment counts do not identify owners or local market share; Census API currently requires key.

sources.name: BLS employment concentration study
sources.limitations: An observational association, not employer-level proof of wage suppression.

sources.name: USAspending agency awards
sources.grain: recipient UEI, award, agency, year, place of performance
sources.limitations: Award obligations are not revenue/profits, employment, or proof of steering.

sources.name: National Transit Database
sources.limitations: Agency spending and ridership do not provide an individual bus schedule.

sources.name: MobilityData public GTFS feed directory
sources.limitations: Feeds can be stale, coverage partial; official operator timetables control.

sources.name: Bureau of Transportation Statistics
sources.limitations: Transport sector costs require service/fare-specific comparisons.

sources.name: FCC National Broadband Map
sources.limitations: Reported availability is not an actual quoted price or service performance; address search may require consent.

sources.name: Census of Governments
sources.limitations: Financial surveys are not current property tax bills.

sources.name: Government local budgets and open data
sources.limitations: No national universal city finance API; join exact boundaries and approved budget years.

sources.name: FEC itemized campaign finance
sources.grain: committee ID, transaction date and filing
sources.limitations: FEC receipts not all original donors; committee filings can amend; reporting includes protected personal information.

sources.name: State election office official directory
sources.limitations: Directory only; download licenses, state transaction schemas and local coverage vary.

sources.name: U.S. House Clerk votes
sources.limitations: Roll calls are not reasons behind votes or direct household effects.

sources.name: U.S. Senate roll calls
sources.limitations: Some official endpoints returned 403 in CI; use validated alternate without access bypass.

sources.name: Congress.gov bills and enactments
sources.limitations: Introduced bill is not effective law.

sources.name: DOJ Voting Section
sources.limitations: Allegations, settlements, decisions and appealed case status require separation.

sources.name: CourtListener docket repository
sources.limitations: Not a complete nationwide court docket source; filings are not holdings.

sources.name: National Center for State Courts / state judicial sources
sources.limitations: Independent original state records control; not all appointment or election histories present.

sources.name: Census congressional districts map boundaries
sources.limitations: District boundary time period and exact address join must be verified.

sources.name: IRS tax-exempt Form 990 bulk files
sources.limitations: Some donors undisclosed and forms lag; grants not campaign contributions.

sources.name: Senate lobbying disclosure
sources.limitations: Lobbying records are not proof of favorable policy or quid pro quo.

sources.name: Office of Government Ethics disclosures
sources.limitations: Not comprehensive elected official holdings; privacy and public access restrictions apply.

sources.name: House Financial Disclosure Reports
sources.limitations: Reported transaction ranges, not exact trade execution prices or full wealth.

sources.name: Senate Financial Disclosures
sources.limitations: Senate disclosures require user acknowledgement; do not bypass terms or authentication.

sources.name: OpenSecrets campaign finance
sources.limitations: Third-party name resolution and licensing review; not a replacement for original FEC records.

gaps.question: What do renters and buyers actually pay by neighborhood and year?
gaps.requiredJoin: ZCTA/county and dated rent/price measures with consistent units
gaps.limitation: A validated FY2026 HUD SAFMR rent-by-bedroom ZCTA benchmark is published, but it is a Housing Choice Voucher benchmark—not observed rent paid, local listings, current asking rents, or an ownership-driven price effect. Neighborhood/year transaction series and legal-owner joins remain unavailable.

verifiedPartialIntegration.type: FY2026 HUD Small Area Fair Market Rent benchmark
verifiedPartialIntegration.missingToResolve: Actual year-matched local rents, lease and asking-price series, verified ownership and causally supported comparisons

gaps.question: Which legal landlord entities ultimately control rentals and developments?
gaps.requiredJoin: parcel-address legal owner → ultimate parent → dated ownership with corporate filings
gaps.limitation: National REIT ownership and local land title are unjoined.

gaps.question: Which zoning, housing and antitrust decisions materially affect supply?
gaps.requiredJoin: municipality and property geometry → dated law, permits, decisions
gaps.limitation: Named owners need not have caused policy decisions.

gaps.question: How much of housing cost growth can be linked to supply, ownership or regulation?
gaps.requiredJoin: comparison areas, building age, financing, trends, rents, vacancies and model specification
gaps.limitation: No causal premium has been estimated.

gaps.question: What has a consistent grocery basket cost locally over time?
gaps.requiredJoin: retail item+size+date+store+geography with product substitution controls
gaps.limitation: National food CPI is not local receipts.

gaps.question: Which local grocery and packaged-food brands share ownership?
gaps.requiredJoin: actual store operator / chain / CIK; outlet address & date
gaps.limitation: Census business counts do not identify each owner's market share.

gaps.question: What competition or price-related public decisions concern food retailers?
gaps.requiredJoin: case and final order → affected local market and timeline
gaps.limitation: FTC inquiry is not an adverse finding.

gaps.question: Does store access or concentration correlate with higher prices in comparable markets?
gaps.requiredJoin: census tract grocery access + comparable market baskets and transport
gaps.limitation: 2025 FARA access ≠ 2026 grocery price level.

gaps.question: What is the actual residential utility tariff and current bill impact?
gaps.requiredJoin: utility service territory → approved tariff, usage, billing period
gaps.limitation: State all-sector average rate is not consumer tariff.

gaps.question: Who owns the utility, suppliers and generation assets serving this address?
gaps.requiredJoin: account service provider, franchise territory, parent filings, asset list
gaps.limitation: ZIP labels do not identify utility service.

gaps.question: Which rate-case orders, fuel cost rules and subsidies changed the price?
gaps.requiredJoin: utility docket → approved customer class rates → effective date
gaps.limitation: Political donations do not establish regulators' motives.

gaps.question: How much of the change is fuel, delivery, tax, use or margin?
gaps.requiredJoin: disaggregated bill, utility expenditure and counterfactual usage
gaps.limitation: Heating fuel mix is not the cause of the household bill.

gaps.question: Which actual prices, premiums and out-of-pocket charges are paid?
gaps.requiredJoin: service code + insurance plan + date + hospital + actual cost sharing
gaps.limitation: Insurer-negotiated rates are not a patient's bill.

gaps.question: Who owns provider groups, hospitals, PBMs and clinics nearby?
gaps.requiredJoin: NPI → facility/operator → parent → transaction/date
gaps.limitation: NPI is not verified beneficial ownership.

gaps.question: Which insurance rules, consolidation cases and payment policies apply?
gaps.requiredJoin: state regulator, final rule, approved acquisition and effective date
gaps.limitation: Open case is not finding of wrongdoing.

gaps.question: Did acquisition or policy measurably change negotiated and patient prices?
gaps.requiredJoin: service-adjusted price trend with comparable non-acquired providers
gaps.limitation: Published 4–14% insurer price finding is from selected studies, not patient copays.

gaps.question: What wages and openings are actually available in local sectors?
gaps.requiredJoin: county NAICS time series + vacancies with employer identification
gaps.limitation: Household income not individual job wage.

gaps.question: Which employers and staffing providers share an owner?
gaps.requiredJoin: operating employers → ultimate parents / merger chronology
gaps.limitation: Many candidate political committees are not operating employers.

gaps.question: Which contracts and workplace rules were enacted and for whom?
gaps.requiredJoin: UEI and place of performance → paid jobs and enacted rule
gaps.limitation: Award obligations ≠ local payroll.

gaps.question: Does local employer concentration explain wage growth after controls?
gaps.requiredJoin: metro-industry employer shares, wage percentiles, controls and validation
gaps.limitation: Observational BLS estimate not a named firm's causal wage impact.

gaps.question: What does infant and preschool childcare cost by county and setting?
gaps.requiredJoin: county FIPS + childcare age/setting + cost vintage
gaps.limitation: 2022 county medians do not estimate 2026 tuition.

gaps.question: Who owns or operates licensed local childcare centres and brands?
gaps.requiredJoin: license number → legal operator → brand and owner as of date
gaps.limitation: 2018 brand rosters are historical; corporate ownership not verified for particular location.

gaps.question: Which subsidy rules and funding allocations affect care?
gaps.requiredJoin: state subsidy rates, eligibility, provider license & funding years
gaps.limitation: Public education spending does not set all private tuition.

gaps.question: Do parent changes, subsidy rules or scarcity influence comparable childcare prices?
gaps.requiredJoin: facility age-setting tuition history, capacity, occupancy, labor and comparison
gaps.limitation: Preschool resident counts do not measure prices or available places.

gaps.question: What do residents pay for fares, tolls, fuel and car insurance?
gaps.requiredJoin: journey, route, fare version, operator and date
gaps.limitation: National transport CPI not a personal commute.

gaps.question: Who owns operators, mobility platforms and local assets?
gaps.requiredJoin: licensed operator / system parent / service territory
gaps.limitation: An asset manager listing does not show which routes are served.

gaps.question: Which fare increases and infrastructure funding decisions occurred?
gaps.requiredJoin: local transit authority board decision, effective date and budget
gaps.limitation: Awards to a project ≠ fare change.

gaps.question: Did competitive options or spending change commute costs?
gaps.requiredJoin: route frequency, travel time, fares and modal alternatives
gaps.limitation: Selected route effects vary by traveler.

gaps.question: What taxes and local service charges actually apply to the resident?
gaps.requiredJoin: tax parcel, municipality, school district, approved budgets, line items
gaps.limitation: National federal spending is not a municipality's bill.

gaps.question: Who owns contractors and broadband providers paid by local governments?
gaps.requiredJoin: contractor UEI → parent; broadband operator → served address
gaps.limitation: EIA and FCC national firms are not all a resident's providers.

gaps.question: Which contracts, grants, subsidies and budget votes were approved?
gaps.requiredJoin: government expenditure / award ID / council vote / date and jurisdiction
gaps.limitation: Awards are obligations, not payments or services delivered.

gaps.question: What measured service improvements resulted per taxpayer dollar?
gaps.requiredJoin: service KPI, disbursement, denominator, quality and independent comparison
gaps.limitation: No complete local service-outcome-to-tax causal join.

gaps.question: Which current laws and elected officials have jurisdiction over an expense?
gaps.requiredJoin: verified address or official district lookup / legal effective date
gaps.limitation: ZIP alone cannot determine district or local tax jurisdiction.

gaps.question: Which donors and lobbying organizations connect to decision makers?
gaps.requiredJoin: original donor → committee → legally matched recipient → decision date
gaps.limitation: FEC name or related board memberships are not ownership or unlawful influence.

gaps.question: What actual votes, orders and certified election outcomes exist?
gaps.requiredJoin: member roll call, law text and effective date, adjudicated case
gaps.limitation: Introduced bills and pending court cases are not completed decisions.

gaps.question: What household outcomes changed after those decisions?
gaps.requiredJoin: policy-exposure boundary and date, comparator and household effect
gaps.limitation: No district policy-to-family causal model published.

gaps.question: Current SEC Exhibit 21 + dated shareholder filings across all named corporate entities; match exact CIK, EIN, LEI, UEI and business aliases.
gaps.requiredJoin: Canonical corporate graph by source, ownership share, dates and legal name; keep conflicts
gaps.limitation: Current ownership edges only for selected case studies; private OpenLedger DB not exported.

gaps.question: Tie named national brands to licensed local establishments without assuming ZIP equals legal boundary.
gaps.requiredJoin: Verified outlet ID+physical address → operator → ultimate parent
gaps.limitation: No national exhaustive licence and facility-to-parent crosswalk.

gaps.question: Measure denominator of local employer/store market shares, not just names or national PAC contributions.
gaps.requiredJoin: Exact market and competitor set plus numerator/denominator and year
gaps.limitation: Census ZIP/CBP API now requires a key; open CSV available. Establishment counts not by ultimate owner.

gaps.question: Reconcile donor and itemized committee transfers with amendments and reporting periods.
gaps.requiredJoin: Original committee IDs + FEC filings + amendments + transaction IDs
gaps.limitation: Existing 1,200 FEC transfer receipts are raw and not amendment reconciled.

gaps.question: Collect official state, county, local and ballot-initiative campaign finance transactions.
gaps.requiredJoin: jurisdiction, filing, contributor, committee and candidate identity
gaps.limitation: State legal coverage differs across 51 authorities; no nationwide transaction census.

gaps.question: Tie Treasury registered UEIs to corporate parents and employer location; avoid conflating unrelated legal subsidiaries.
gaps.requiredJoin: UEI award ID+entity hierarchy+place of performance+time
gaps.limitation: Federal obligations ≠ companywide revenue, donation ROI or local wages.

gaps.question: Join local transaction/tuition/rent prices to precise parent company and observed service quality.
gaps.requiredJoin: price within same product/category, time, geography, and legal operator
gaps.limitation: National price CPI and corporate ownership cannot explain individual bills.

gaps.question: Download and reconcile certified state/DC election canvasses.
gaps.requiredJoin: certified contest returns, district, date, stage, original authority
gaps.limitation: Existing official source directory has 51 authorities, but zero nationally reconciled canvasses.

gaps.question: Reconcile full state redistricting histories with member-level original legislative roll calls.
gaps.requiredJoin: official bill/version → chamber/member vote → final law/court effective date
gaps.limitation: 0 verified exhaustive state-wide bill history sweeps and bounded roll-call sample only.

gaps.question: Case filings, merits rulings, appeals, orders and final dispositions for election-map cases.
gaps.requiredJoin: docket → ruling/outcome/status/date with primary document
gaps.limitation: Nationwide full litigation lifecycle not verified.

gaps.question: State judges' verified appointment/election/retention histories and deciding authorities.
gaps.requiredJoin: judge identifier+selection mechanism+term dates
gaps.limitation: No complete jurisdiction by year dataset.

gaps.question: Verify congressional trades, beneficial holdings and recusals with issuer identity and relevant policy dates.
gaps.requiredJoin: member+date range+issuer CIK+policy action with privacy guard
gaps.limitation: Disclosures report ranges; does not establish unethical trade or price effect.

gaps.question: Distinguish lobbying contact/filing from actual legislative or procurement result.
gaps.requiredJoin: client, filing, bill number, action date, company UEI, time controls
gaps.limitation: Lobbying registration not direct evidence of a vote being altered.

gaps.question: Build permitted funding flows across non-profits and political committees with unknown donors explicit.
gaps.requiredJoin: EIN + fiscal year + grantee and committee transfer IDs
gaps.limitation: Some ultimate donors are legally undisclosed, not retrievable from public sources.

gaps.question: Reconcile district geometries, effective dates and court-ordered revisions.
gaps.requiredJoin: date-qualified geometry crosswalk, not ZIP fuzzy match
gaps.limitation: Existing state-legislative downloads are not verified exhaustive legal-map timeline.

gaps.question: Distinguish correlation, case allegations and causal neighborhood cost impacts.
gaps.requiredJoin: registered methodology, comparison geography, confounders, sensitivity, uncertainty
gaps.limitation: No comprehensive causal study supports a nationwide billionaire surcharge or donor ROI.

gaps.question: Validate third-party licenses and allowed use before automated copying into public datasets.
gaps.requiredJoin: URL, retrieval date, license rights, data transformation and record hash
gaps.limitation: Free viewing does not imply automated redistribution rights.

gaps.question: Time-stamp public source snapshots and signal stale/partial live retrieval in the application.
gaps.requiredJoin: source retrieval/coverage time, data cutoff, update SLA and failure status
gaps.limitation: Source-indexed descriptions are not live data connections.

gaps.question: Audit static page assets, dataset references, back links, and bug-report affordances across every page.
gaps.requiredJoin: repo build path, Vercel route, source data files and browser tests
gaps.limitation: Source directories do not guarantee runtime pages render.

repairPolicy: Only mark a gap resolved after original measurements, entity identities, dated decisions, legal permission and appropriate comparative estimates can be reproduced. A source link is not resolution.
